name: cadastro-localizacao
script: (async()=>{for(const [name,value] of Object.entries({"storeName":"Restaurante Sabor da Casa","legalName":"Restaurante Exemplo Ltda","cnpj":"11222333000181","email":"teste@example.test","phone":"11999999999"})){const e=document.querySelector('[name='+name+']');Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set.call(e,value);e.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(e=>e.textContent==='Avançar etapa').click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,350));scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'instant'});})()
